content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Stop immediately — sharp or persistent pain means you need to see a professional before continuing. Safety first, Alex.

If it's just soreness (muscle fatigue feeling), that's normal after deadlifts. But if it's sharp, shooting, or doesn't feel right, get it checked out. Once cleared, drop the load, dial in your form (neutral spine, core braced, hips back), and build back up gradually within a pain-free range. Never push through genuine pain. 💪
